boundary_criteria.criterion: classifier_validation.json case with passed=false; expected adjudication label remains blinded
classifier confidence is low with an abstract
classifier label and semantic reason signals are in tension
classifier reason signals omit a normal boundary-separating signal
high-confidence boundary control used only to fill the target

quota_policy.failed_invariant_cases: after deduplication, include every classifier_validation case with passed=false before the remaining boundary quota
quota_policy.primary_boundary: include title-only, low-confidence, and medium-confidence retain/deprioritize rows before high-confidence controls
quota_policy.stratification: question_id, classifier decision, evidence basis, confidence, and boundary tier, with deterministic proportional quotas and minority-stratum minimums when capacity permits
quota_policy.batch_alignment: allocate high-confidence controls to complete 200-row question batches before assigning further 200-row blocks
quota_policy.fallback: if fewer than 5000 candidates exist, select every candidate
